Name: Super Huge Sheds
Author: Kyznikov
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]
This mod will let you have a very big space of Shed. The already big Shed is upgradeable to an even bigger space of Big Shed. There are also settings which let you adjust the price and resources for balancing purpose.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Just drag and drop or copy paste the downloaded file into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, like any other mods.

[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]
You can edit the config using the config.json file generated by the game, or using GMCM mod inside the game.
[list]
[*]Use vanilla price and resources [b](default: false)[/b] - If enabled, vanilla price and resources needed to build will be used, any other settings will be ignored
[*]Shed - Wood Amount [b](default: 400)[/b] - Change the amount of wood needed to build Shed
[*]Shed - Cost [b](default: 50000)[/b] - Change the cost needed to build Shed
[*]Big Shed - Wood Amount [b](default: 800)[/b] - Change the amount of wood needed to upgrade to Big Shed
[*]Big Shed - Stone Amount [b](default: 600)[/b] - Change the amount of stone needed to upgrade to Big Shed
[*]Big Shed - Cost [b](default: 100000)[/b] - Change the cost needed to upgrade to Big Shed
[/list]
[size=5][b]Notice[/b][/size]
- Exit the Carpenter's Shop if you were inside when changing any values and then re-enter. Any value changed while outside the Carpenter's Shop will automatically applied when entering.
- Use only numbers when typing value. Entering anything other than only numbers, will revert the value to vanilla value.
- For reference on vanilla value, visit [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Shed]this link[/url]
